To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) expert system explanation is not a single, monolithic technology, but rather a set of techniques that must be chosen based on the needs of the particular end user; and (2) explanation technology must be developed in concert with the system's knowledge base to produce explanations that are meaningful to the end user and to the domain expert.
The explanation requirements of end users of expert systems have changed significantly since the early days of expert system development.
expert system explanation techniques have evolved from the early days of expert systems research to the present day, and that these techniques are not as good as they could be.
